description: A fine-grained stone used for sharpening the edges of steel tools and weapons. Regular maintenance with a whetstone keeps bladed weapons in peak condition. Essential for any warrior or craftsperson.
name: Whetstone
notes: Hone: +1 damage on every weapon hit in your next fight. Honing doesn't wear it.
Sharpen…: 10 minutes brings a worn slashing or piercing melee weapon back up to Worn. Only a smith makes it new.
